strings.(얼음으로 가득한 공간, 오랜 시간 동안 두 존재가 싸우고 있지만 도저히: (In a space filled with ice, two beings have fought for a long time, with no end in sight.)
strings.네가 소멸할 때까지 계속 할 거라고!: I'll keep going until you're destroyed!
Then I have no choice. I'll face you until then.
strings.왜 정령들이 이곳으로 몰려오는 거야? 저건 하르모니아와 기아스, 저놈들은: Why are spirits swarming here? That's Harmonia and Geis. What are they doing here?
strings.정령왕님께서 무슨 일이세요?: Spirit Kings, what brings you here?
Heart of Iris, you no longer need to fight in this place.
strings.정령왕 따위가 곧 신의 몸을 차지할 나의 싸움을 방해해?: Mere Spirit Kings dare interfere with my battle? I am about to claim a god's body!
strings.(이블오더가 방해자의 등장에 짜증을 내면서 앞으로 나간다.): (Evil Order advances, irritated by the intruders.)
strings.이 세계를 어지럽히는 존재가 이리스를 괴롭혀서 만든 당신, 이제 사라지세: You were created by a being that torments Iris and throws this world into chaos. Now, disappear.
strings.(하르모니아와 기아스의 손짓으로 정령들이 날아와 이블오더를 붙잡는다.): (At Harmonia and Geis's gestures, the spirits fly forward and seize Evil Order.)
strings.캬악, 하찮은 정령왕 따위가 주인의 분신이나 다름없는 날 어찌하겠다고?: Kyaa! What can paltry Spirit Kings do to one who is all but an avatar of their master? Ridiculous.
A true master would never act as you do.
One who sows discord in the world is no master of ours.
strings.이리스, 겁먹지 말아요. 세레스의 운명을 따라 신으로 거듭난 소녀여. 이: Iris, don't be afraid. Girl reborn as a god through Seres's fate... Now, act for your adventurer's sake.
strings.나는 이 세계를 삼키고 신이 될 존재. 날 거스르지 마. 너는 계속해서: I will swallow this world and become its god. Do not defy me. You must keep fighting me. You cannot kill...
strings.당신과 나는 이리스의 마음이기도 해요. 이 안에선 절대 사라지지 않는 것: You and I are both parts of Iris's heart. I know neither of us can truly disappear within it.
That's right. You understand perfectly. Heh heh...
strings.사람에게는 여러 마음이 있어요. 이리스도 그래요. 그중 당신은 나쁜 마음: People hold many feelings in their hearts. Iris is no different. You are her darker feelings, mingled with fear, and you want them to keep growing.
strings.이리스는 조금씩 안정을 찾고 있어요. 당신보다 다른 마음이 더 커지길 바: But Iris is finding peace, little by little. Everyone who wishes for her other feelings to grow stronger than you is helping her.
strings.무슨 말을 하고 싶은 거지?: What are you trying to say?
I hadn't realized it. All along, everyone was here with me...
...Sleep now. This is for everyone's sake...
What? If you had gained power, I would have known...
strings.(이리스가 움직이지 못하는 이블오더를 향해 손을 뻗는다. 잠시 후, 정령: (Iris reaches toward the immobilized Evil Order. The spirits begin wrapping around Evil Order's body and face.)
I won't retreat like this! I will become this world's god... Its god...
strings.(시간이 흐르고, 이블오더를 감쌌던 정령들이 흩어진다. 그 앞엔 얼어버린: (Time passes, and the spirits surrounding Evil Order disperse. Only Evil Order's frozen form remains.)
strings.그런데 가이아 님은 어디 계시지? 가이아 님! 가이아 님!: But where is Gaia? Lady Gaia! Lady Gaia!
strings.[제가 어디 있는지는 지금 중요하지 않아요. 이리스, 부탁이 있어요. 앞: [Where I am doesn't matter now. Iris, I have a favor to ask. Stay beside the adventurer. Let them become your adventurer, no one else's. Not even mine...]
strings.(가이아의 목소리가 사라지고 이리스의 눈가에 눈물이 맺힌다. 그리고 얼어: (Gaia's voice fades, and tears gather in Iris's eyes. A vivid, beautiful rainbow rises over the frozen world's sky.)
